{

    },

    {
      "login": "w0xlt",

    {
      "login": "Bortlesboat",

    {
      "login": "Eunovo",

      "note": "Concept ACK and ACK; commented on documentation and enum organization"

    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "pinged reviewer for re-review"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3048078577",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Coupling to CLIENT_VERSION causes false upgrade or downgrade detection when switching between versions even if wallet code is identical",
      "quote": "the coupling is confusing and makes testing harder",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3049818044",
        "c:3049933892",
        "c:3050272556"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3050272556",
      "settled_by_quote": "I've updated the PR to do a combination of @maflcko's and @ryanofsky's suggestions."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2941109291",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Failed WriteLastDecryptedFeatures still updates the in-memory guard, preventing retry of the write on subsequent unlocks",
      "quote": "If `WriteLastDecryptedFeatures()` fails, this still updates the in-memory guard, so the write won't be retried on subsequent unlocks.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2977816165"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2977816165",
      "settled_by_quote": "It doesn't matter. The automatic upgrades are no-ops if they've already been done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3145118367",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Using high bits and 1ULL for int32_t wastes 3/4ths of available version space",
      "quote": "seems something of a shame to waste 3/4ths of the available space",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3149906809"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3149906809",
      "settled_by_quote": "Changed `VERSION_MASK` to `MIN_VERSION = (1L << 19)`, and for the subsequent version number to increment on that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3145159898",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "Unclear extension and compatibility plan once more than 64 features are needed",
      "quote": "What happens when you want to implement a 65th wallet feature?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3149899553"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3149899553",
      "settled_by_quote": "for the 64th feature, there are actually 2 flags, one flag to indicate that there are more feature flags, and then we extend the record with another `uint64_t`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3151899583",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "Missing cs_wallet locking annotations on SetLastDecryptedFeatures",
      "quote": "`GUARDED_BY(cs_wallet)` ? if so, `SetLastDecryptedFeatrues()` needs `EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED`",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3156344543"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3156344543",
      "settled_by_quote": "Sure, done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3151916221",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Features are not initialized upon wallet creation",
      "quote": "Should this also initalize the features?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3156345085"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3156345085",
      "settled_by_quote": "Indeed, done"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5704724561",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Stale LAST_DECRYPTED_FEATURES remaining after a downgrade can restore old features on locked reload and prevent upgrades",
      "quote": "Should we delete `LAST_DECRYPTED_FEATURES` when loading a wallet that was last opened by a client that doesn’t support this record?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5705381423"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "r:5229324703",
      "settled_by_quote": "ACK 1f5c103fe079d7e42003b8b29c156d3fc9204053"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3049244656",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "It shouldn't hurt to add more metadata to help detect when there might be a mix of old data in a newer format and new data in an older format in the same wallet.",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {

    },
    {
      "id": "r:4690084116",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "The revised wallet-client version namespace, creation-time metadata initialization, and cs_wallet annotations address the intervening review feedback; I did not find additional issues. CI is green.",
      "substantive": true

      "id": "r:4992707719",

    {
      "id": "r:5009644272",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "rebase preserving the upstream WriteVersion(int) documentation/argument handling and best-block-locator comment, with no change to the feature-record logic. Built in WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 and ran wallet_tests, walletdb_tests, walletload_tests, wallet_crypto_tests, init_tests, plus wallet_createwallet.py (RPC and --usecli), wallet_encryption.py, and wallet_migration.py against v28.2; all passed.",
      "substantive": true

    {
      "id": "r:5229324703",

  "notes": "Initial record. Multiple reviewers raised design and correctness concerns (decoupling from node CLIENT_VERSION, version bit allocation, 64-feature extension strategy, locking annotations, initializing features on create, and erasing stale decrypted features on legacy reload), all of which were addressed and settled."

support.reason: It shouldn't hurt to add more metadata to help detect when there might be a mix of old data in a newer format and new data in an older format in the same wallet.

The revised wallet-client version namespace, creation-time metadata initialization, and cs_wallet annotations address the intervening review feedback; I did not find additional issues. CI is green.

rebase preserving the upstream WriteVersion(int) documentation/argument handling and best-block-locator comment, with no change to the feature-record logic. Built in WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 and ran wallet_tests, walletdb_tests, walletload_tests, wallet_crypto_tests, init_tests, plus wallet_createwallet.py (RPC and --usecli), wallet_encryption.py, and wallet_migration.py against v28.2; all passed.

result.notes: Initial record. Multiple reviewers raised design and correctness concerns (decoupling from node CLIENT_VERSION, version bit allocation, 64-feature extension strategy, locking annotations, initializing features on create, and erasing stale decrypted features on legacy reload), all of which were addressed and settled.
